# ECC: Behavior-focused testing

Follow [AGENTS.md](../../../AGENTS.md), .editorconfig and the requested scope.
Apply the project adaptations below before the generic upstream examples.

## Project adaptations

- Use xUnit for the .NET projects and the configured Vitest script for the PWA; inspect nearby tests before choosing fixtures or assertions.
- For a bug, run a regression test that fails for the intended reason, make the smallest fix and rerun that same test before refactoring.
- Do not run ECC's package-manager detector or install sample Jest, React, Bun or coverage tooling. The project already specifies its runners.
- Keep tests focused on user-visible behavior and meaningful boundaries; instruction-only edits do not require synthetic application tests.
- The full suite in AGENTS.md remains required. Use existing coverage configuration; do not add an arbitrary 80% threshold or new evidence-report directory.
- Record actual RED/GREEN results and any unverified checks in the PR body. Routine test commands within the authorized task do not need repeated approval.

## Upstream reference

Read [ECC Behavior-focused testing](../../../docs/ai/ecc/skills/tdd-workflow/SKILL.md) and apply the relevant sections.
Use only available tools and task-relevant references. Upstream package commands,
framework examples, agent names and scripts are illustrative; use the project's configured
commands and existing skills. Perform research and review inline when delegation is
unavailable or outside the authorized task.
